newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE MONEY RATES MIXED IN ACTIVE MARKET.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE MONEY RATES MIXED IN ACTIVE MARKET.

text.p: Short-term trading rates on Zimbabwe's money market were quoted mixed in fairly active trade on Monday, dealers said.
The central Reserve Bank auctioned Z$500 million worth of 91-day treasury bills at 17.31 percent, slightly down from 17.36 percent on Friday.
Meanwhile, treasury bills were being sold in the secondary market unchanged at 17 percent and call money was also steady at 17 percent.
NCD bills maturing after 30, 60 and 90 days were quoted at 18.50 and 17.25 percent (buying and selling respectively) from Friday's 18 and 17.50 percent.
Bankers acceptances edged up to 18.25 from 17.65 percent (buying) but were being sold softer at 17.20 percent from 17.35 percent.
The Reserve Bank indicated an opening market surplus of Z$24 million, down from a previous surplus of Z$130 million.
